name: clawness-openclaw
description: OpenClaw plugin discovery manifest for Clawness. A git install (openclaw plugins install git:github.com/fullymiddleaged/Clawness) clones the whole repo, so this root package.json + openclaw.plugin.json point the host at the prebuilt adapter entry, while the Python engine (hooks/, clawness/, rules/) sits right here for the adapter to shell out to. All dev/build/test for the adapter lives in openclaw/.
